phase: Production 7.2.7 r38 default: Denial at boot (GPU accelerated), Wi-Fi (battery-capable), hotspot, Bluetooth, power key, 3-level brightness, per-core CPU idle, DDR scaling (bwmon + GPU OPP votes, input boost), GCC/GPUCC sync_state, haptics (AW8697), light/proximity (VCNL36866), logo LED (rgb:logo)
next: Following the user's 13-step plan. r38 default passes hwcheck (vibration, leds, sensors, buttons, display, gpu, bt, touch); GPU soak clean (3000 wake cycles, glmark2 1656-1675, no GMU errors); smoothness 0.4-3.4 dropped frames per gesture; wake to first frame 119-135 ms; journald debug drop-in and brightness tools removed. Open: audio (card and amplifiers work, but any stream run hard-resets the phone at the ADSP, r42-r49, see test-results), IMU behind the SLPI sensor DSP (r51: TZ rejects the stock SLPI image at pas_init_image with -EINVAL, see test-results), user confirmation of haptics/logo LED and the double-tap-on-wake behaviour. 2026-09-25: r38 boots on battery (unplugged reboot, Wi-Fi 39.8 s, BT 42.3 s) and idles at 114 mA / 0.98 W (r26 191 mA); SoC-wide sleep (CX/DDR) never entered yet. 2026-09-25: default is production-7.2.7-r52 (r51 minus the SLPI overlay; r38 fell back to V11 after a stalled boot). Stock 5.4 capture: the stock kernel's PIL is also refused by TZ for SLPI and CDSP (event 0x30001f) while the ADSP loads; the secure firmware on both slots is stock WW33. Sensors/CDSP need the runtime state stock Android sets up before early-boot, which only a stock-Android capture (userdata backup first) can show. Brightness: stock drives the Iris6 in PT mode; ours is bypass (3 levels). Audio 2026-09-25: the stock ASUS 5.4 stack (rebuilt, RAM capture) plays MultiMedia1->SEN_MI2S_RX without a reset. Upstream 7.2.7 hangs on the first writei into the q6asm PCM buffer (no DSP command needed, mmap stores are fine), then hard-resets about 10 s later; see test-results 2026-09-24-power-idle-ddr.md.
